header:
Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute
United States · Mathematics PhD (strong applied/computational emphasis)
Roster and rank verification handled separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A four-year U.S. bachelor’s or equivalent must be awarded before enrollment; a completed UChicago
bachelor’s meets that credential route. International applicants are accepted. Research fit is a serious concern:
current mathematics faculty concentrate on applied/computational areas, and no clear primary adviser in the
requested AG/arithmetic/NT/representation areas was identified. [s1] [s6] [s7]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Create a graduate application, choose one program for the term (multiple applications per term prohibited),
upload transcripts, personal statement, CV and two referees. Review carefully: submitted applications cannot
be edited. Pay fee electronically after submission. English waiver is applied after submission/review. [s1] [s8]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact graduate mathematics before investing in an application: the full current two-page faculty roster and
PhD page do not establish a primary adviser in the requested fields. Do not infer a pure AG/NT research option
from the degree title alone. [s2] [s6] [s7]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Public portal supports account creation and returning-user login; one application per term. Central instructions
prohibit changes/revisions after submission. Public referee-specific invitation trigger, receipt status, updates
and reuse are not established. [s1] [s8]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 doctoral application date is explicit. Stipend figures cover 2026-27 only. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 doctoral deadline: December 15, 2026. Late applications accepted but timely applications receive
priority. Time zone not published. Spring 2027 deadline was August 15, 2026, already passed as of this report.
[s1]

acceptance with available aid. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL 88/revised 4.5, IELTS Academic 6.5, Duolingo 120 or PTE 59; scores older than two years unavailable
from agencies. Institution code 2757. Department may require more than the institute minimum. [s1]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Applicants who have OR WILL HAVE earned an undergraduate/graduate degree from a regionally accredited
U.S. institution may be waived. Thus a completing UChicago bachelor’s is expressly within the education route.
Waiver is applied only after submission and Graduate Admissions review. [s1]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Optional for mathematics; current central page requires GRE only for Management PhD and strongly
recommends it for some other named fields, not math. Code 2757. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No separate Mathematics Subject requirement is identified in the public mathematics/central checklist.
Whether optional subject scores are evaluated is not stated. [s1] [s2]

Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Résumé/CV required. Prompt paraphrase: education, employment, internships and relevant research;
international applicants on OPT/CPT should describe current activities. No public word/page cap, file type or
typography rule. [s1]
Statement of purpose; Personal / background statement; Research-interest statement [Standing

One personal statement required. Prompt paraphrase: academic/research interests and career goals in relation
to the program, plus influential academic, research, professional or personal experiences. No published length
or formatting cap. Separate research statements/proposals are specified only for named other programs. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Institute AY 2026-27 minimum: USD 28,337 academic year and USD 9,446 summer, USD 37,783 combined.
This is a minimum for stipend appointments, not proof that mathematics guarantees a summer appointment or
2027-28 rates. Tuition remission/waivers are awarded by the admitted school; exact fees/health coverage must
be obtained in the offer. [s3] [s4] [s5]
Years of support; Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Department says fully supported doctoral students should plan to finish in four or five years; this is not a fixed
funding guarantee. Continuation depends on funding and performance. TAs complete institute training,
department orientation and a TA seminar; TA/RA full-time registration minimum is nine credits/semester. [s2]
[s3] [s4]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
International students can apply, but the reviewed funding pages do not provide a blanket citizenship rule for
every fellowship. Federal aid eligibility described for U.S. citizens/eligible noncitizens should not be assumed
for F-1 status; confirm assistantship terms directly. [s1] [s5]
Extra funding application; Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Department lists TA, RA and internal/external fellowships, with details from the graduate coordinator/adviser.
No math-specific separate scholarship essay, additional reference or universally applicable funding form is
public. Faculty grant-funded RAs depend on research match. [s2] [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 75, nonrefundable, paid electronically after application submission. [s1]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Published automatic categories: RPI alumni, current students, employees and employee spouses. No
UChicago/F-1-specific or general hardship waiver is established for Mathematics PhD. Do not apply RPI-at-Work
webinar waivers to this campus PhD without confirmation. [s1]
